why: Picking between near-synonym labels with no derivation path, and the item is broken — the key says 'task scheduling' while its own explanation argues for 'project scheduling'.
Recognising commercial product names; nothing about project management tells you which brands exist.
The odd one out is a scope concern rather than a time concern — inconsistent in kind, not merely off the process list.
Producing dated activities from sequence, duration and constraints is what developing a schedule means; the name is transparent.
Reasoning about direct versus indirect consequences, but 'least affected' is subjective and the bank itself warns the printed key may differ.
Identifying and documenting what work exists is definition rather than estimation or sequencing; follows from the words.
Predecessors, successors and resource gating are all relationships; rework is recognisably a different kind of thing.
Follows from cost being resources priced out, so the resource estimate is what a cost estimate consumes.
Asks only what the three points are, and 'three-point' plus a range naturally means optimistic, most likely and pessimistic — no figure is computed.
Choosing the guide's fixed term over an equally sensible English synonym ('deconstruction'); the distinction is conventional.
The false option is self-contradictory — a calendar of availability cannot cover resources not yet identified.
The named pair of compression techniques; the distractors are genuine scheduling techniques, so only knowing which two carry the label separates them.
Changing logical dependencies is by definition sequencing work, so the process follows from what was done, not from an ITTO row.
Rests on the convention that overlap is recorded as a lead on a finish-to-start link rather than reclassifying the relationship type.
Membership of the guide's enumerated activity-attributes list; 'when to perform' is excluded only for being off it.
Follows from who is accountable for delivering against an externally imposed date — both the schedule owner and the resource suppliers.
The breadth of 'resource' follows from the ordinary meaning of the word; an all-inclusive option needs no recall.
